findings.cause: Hypothesis: remaining limits are silhouette/material representation and compositional architecture, not missing density.
findings.action: Retain as opt-in provisional experiment; stop before larger investment and ask human art direction after diagnostic seed/regression captures.

findings.evidence: Readable faces replace black lumps but suggest rounded generic boulders rather than convincing weathered rock.
findings.cause: Known smooth distorted-sphere representation lacks a convincing fracture/weathering language.
findings.action: Do not promote the rock construction into shared approved rules.

implementation: Single stone pigment/tint relationship with readable cool fill, physical shadow refresh, shared irregular low-contrast soil contact and overlapping grass.
demonstrated: Asymmetric foreground weight and contact are clearer than C1; black stone defect fixed without global exposure changes. Full landscape is improved over the original granular field but not beautiful enough to approve.
failure: Gate C artistic target not met; no overall or human approval. Do not claim a robustness gate pass even if later diagnostic seeds are technically sound.
reusable: Material multiplication and cached-shadow diagnostics generalize. Parent-child dressing/contact is a promising relationship; this rock technique remains proposed.
specific: Current seed-specific stone clusters and fibre geometry are experimental savanna presentation, not measured geology/ecological occurrences.
humanFeedbackNeeded: Choose whether the continuous-field/rooted-fibre direction warrants a larger representation investment, or reject the direction.
